# Raaja Riddle

> Daily Illayaraja music trivia for fans. A new riddle every day, points based on speed, and a leaderboard to climb.

Raaja Riddle is a fan-club quiz app celebrating the music of legendary Indian composer Ilaiyaraaja. Players solve a daily music riddle, earn points based on how fast they answer, build streaks, and compete on a public leaderboard.

## Pages

- [Home & Leaderboard](/): Today's riddle, the all-time and monthly leaderboard, player streaks, and points.
